notes: Window Jan 2025–Dec 2026; one appearance = one band on one dated bill (multi-band bills credit every named band). Solo performers, DJs, open mics, comedy, school ensembles and generic theme nights were skipped; solo-vs-band calls were made from the billing name and may be wrong in a few cases (e.g. names like 'Monte Maybe', 'Hubbell Benson', 'Kiersten Blue' were treated as solo and dropped). Touring national club bands (e.g. Eyehategod, Dwarves, Jackyl, Trapt, Sponge) are included as bands per the 'treat every band the same' instruction; the page can filter by totals. Already-crawled venues (J&P, Artie's, Havana, HVV, Triumph New Hope, Peddler's Village, New Hope Winery, Flemington DIY, Birdhouse, Hopewell Porchfest, Woolsey Park) were re-parsed from the earlier raw downloads so single appearances are now included. Songkick-sourced dates may be off by one day. Wayback-sourced J&P/Triumph/Havana months have gaps (see coverage). Blocked: Birdhouse (22 event pages behind a bot check), Unionville, Conclave, Sand Castle, Hewn, River Horse, NJ Stage and loveflemington (Cloudflare); Bandsintown 403. I did not retry past bot checks. Not found online: Shad Fest lineups, Lambertville Porchfest 2025, Hopewell Porchfest 2026, Soulstice 2025 per-day lineup, Pattenburg House calendar, Beneduce performer names. Flounder Brewing (Hillsborough) and Readington Brewery (Neshanic Station) sit just outside Hunterdon's border but were in the lead list; other area agents may also cover them. Band descriptions for bands not seen in earlier passes are minimal (venue-based); genre 'unknown' where not stated by the source.
